A tale that [[Thom Merrilin]] taunts the [[Emond's Field]]ers with when he arrives for the [[Bel Tine]] celebrations.

==Parallels==
The name of the protagonist in this tale is taken from the popular fairytales of [[Wikipedia:Jack the Giant Killer|Jack the Giant Killer]] and [[Wikipedia:Jack and the Beanstalk|Jack and the Beanstalk]].
